changes: #1928: the sequencer clock is read once a frame through the base's ev_audio_frame_prepare (fm_prepare_frame), and fm_lfo_frame_entry (0x4000cf50) leaves the LFO pass to stock's inline loop unless an FM voice sounds or a routed START is pending; po_lfo3b (0x4000d03e) is gone.

#1974: FM Synth answers ev_in_use (registration.c fm_in_use: an FM/1 track in the live Part or, swept a Part and a FLEX slot a UI tick, in any Part of any bank, working or saved, a legacy marker slot, GLIDE on, a pick through fm_admit_track). While it answers 0 its seven frame-path detours (runtime.json "rests") and its STATIC renderer and FLEX start entries (the row's "restingReferences") hold stock's bytes.
ev_audio_frame_prepare never rests, so fm_prepare_frame returns at once while fm_fr's FR_IDLE is set, and FR_REBASE makes the clock drop the step measured across the missed frames.
